completeProfile.label: Complete your profile
completeProfile.description: Answer the short questionnaire so your coach knows your level, hand and goals.

connectCoach.label: Connect a coach
connectCoach.description: Approve or send a request so your coach can plan with you.

addTournament.label: Add a tournament
addTournament.description: Plan your season and keep travel and costs together.

addPlayer.label: Add a player
addPlayer.description: Send a request with the player's public ID, or approve an incoming one.

planSession.label: Plan a session
planSession.description: Build drills in the Session Builder and save them as a plan for a player.

createTeam.label: Create a team
createTeam.description: Group your players so you can schedule and filter by squad.

linkChild.label: Link your child
linkChild.description: Send a request with your child's public ID, or approve the one they sent you.

reviewConsent.label: Review consent
reviewConsent.description: Read how your child's data is handled and what you have consented to.

seeWeek.label: See the week
seeWeek.description: Your child's sessions and tournaments appear on the calendar once their coach has scheduled them.

setUpAcademy.label: Set up your academy
setUpAcademy.description: Name your academy and describe its size in the profile questionnaire.

admin.title: No admin tools yet
admin.description: This page will hold user management, relationship oversight and system alerts. Until then, the admin dashboard has the live overview.

coach.description: Your calendar brings together every training you schedule and your players' tournaments. Schedule the first session and it appears here.

observer.description: Your child's trainings and tournaments appear here once their coach has scheduled them.

player.description: Your trainings, matches and tournaments come together here. Add a tournament to start planning your season.

player.description: Connections link you to your coach and your family. Send a request with their public ID, or approve one they sent you.

observer.description: A connection links you to your child's account so you can follow their schedule and expenses. Send a request with their public ID, or approve the one they sent you.

matches.title: No matches logged yet
